subject: Mobile Development
title: Martin Cooper's Historic Call
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Martin Cooper's Historic Call.

hook.text: On April 3, 1973, a Motorola engineer stood on a New York sidewalk and made history.

buildup.text: Martin Cooper pulled out a brick-sized prototype and dialed his rival at Bell Labs.

discovery.text: The call lasted just a few minutes, but it proved wireless telephony worked.

twist.text: The phone weighed over a kilogram and its battery died after just 20 minutes.

climax.text: It took another decade before the first commercial mobile phone reached stores.

punchline.text: The first mobile call was a flex on a rival.

quiz.question: Who made the first handheld mobile phone call?
